headline: GlobalFoundries to make US silicon interposers for TSMC
summary: GlobalFoundries signed a five-year, $2 billion deal to produce silicon interposers for TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging in the US, supporting domestic production of AI and HPC accelerator chips.

claims.statement: TSMC tapped GlobalFoundries to bolster US silicon interposer production in a $2 billion deal.

sources.quote: TSMC taps GlobalFoundries to bolster US silicon interposer production in $2B deal

claims.statement: The five-year agreement makes GlobalFoundries part of TSMC's CoWoS supply chain in the US.

sources.quote: GlobalFoundries to produce silicon interposers for TSMC's CoWoS in the US — Five-year agreement valued at $2 billion

GlobalFoundries becomes a part of TSMC's CoWoS supply chain in the U.S.: set to participate in production of leading-edge AI and HPC accelerators without investing in leading-edge process technologies.

claims.statement: Advanced packaging technology like this is essential to domestic production of high-performance AI datacenter semiconductors.

sources.quote: Advanced packaging tech is essential to the domestic production of high-performance semiconductors used in AI datacenters
